# Osorio Lab — Laboratory on Polymer Materials & Organ Printing

> Research group of Prof. Dr. Anayancy Osorio-Madrazo at the University of Bayreuth (Germany).
> Functional polymer materials — from hydrogels and bioinspired fibres to bioprinted tissues.

The laboratory develops functional polymer materials for technological and biomedical
applications, combining polymer chemistry, materials science, physics, engineering and
biomedicine. Core work includes 3D bioprinting / organ printing, hydrogels, (nano)composites,
bioinspired fibres, tissue engineering and controlled drug release.

## Facts

- **Lead:** Prof. Dr. Anayancy Osorio-Madrazo (ORCID 0000-0003-1312-622X)
- **Institution:** University of Bayreuth, Germany — Chair of Organ Printing
- **Address:** Universitätsstr. 30, NW IV, 95447 Bayreuth, Germany
- **Email:** anayancy.osorio-madrazo@uni-bayreuth.de
- **Phone:** +49 921-55-7961
- **Language:** English (site content)

## Research areas

Hydrogels, fiber spinning, (nano)composites, sustainable materials, biomineralization,
bioinspired materials, biomimetics, synchrotron X-ray scattering (SAXS/WAXS, in situ),
3D bioprinting and additive manufacturing, heterophase polymerization, polymer micro- and
nanoparticles, controlled drug release, tissue engineering, 3D cell culture, biosensors,
polysaccharide nanofibers, nanotechnology, size-exclusion chromatography (SEC/MALLS),
rheology, micro- and nanomechanical testing.
